$entry = $zip.Entries | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq "document.xml" }
$content = (New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($entry.Open())).ReadToEnd()
$regex = '<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>'
[regex]::Matches($content, $regex) | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }
